    Prime Video has renewed the hit thriller series Cross for a third season. The eight-episode Season Three, produced by Amazon MGM Studios and Paramount Television Studios, will stream exclusively on Prime Video in more than 240 countries and territories worldwide. Based upon characters created by James Patterson, the series, created by Ben Watkins, stars Aldis Hodge as the brilliant and complex detective Alex Cross. Season Three will continue to expand the high-stakes world of the iconic character, building on the show’s gripping storytelling and powerful performances. In Season Two of Cross, billionaire business titan Lance Durand (Matthew Lillard) calls the FBI for protection after receiving a death threat — one that links him to the murder of a billionaire playboy. Detective Alex Cross and FBI Agent Kayla Craig (Alona Tal) lead a new joint mission to protect Durand and to find the killer, who leaves behind gruesome clues.
